CREATE VIEW [DW].[FactTrustFundValue_PBIen_View]
	AS 

WITH FactTrustFundValue_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue_PBIen as FDL
)

Select TRU.*
from DW.FactTrustFundValue_PBIen as TRU
    INNER JOIN FactTrustFundValue_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = TRU.BusinessDateSK
